verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's MCP server documentation explicitly states you can pull error data into AI tools 'with no data sharing required,' and the product is self-hosted/open-source, giving users control over where data goes and implicitly preventing vendor-side AI training on their data. However, there is no explicit privacy policy or documented commitment stating GlitchTip (or its AI features) will never use customer data for AI model training. Missing for 10: an explicit AI-training data-use policy statement, contractual/DPA language addressing model training, and independent confirmation of this claim.
